actual_problem: QIF v0.2.1 is executable but now contains many entities across docs, schemas, examples, and verifier logic; without consolidation, v0.3 pilot users may not know which concepts own which responsibilities or what verifier success means.
why_it_matters: A pilot must be explainable end to end: captured judgment, derived pattern, quality intent, applicability decision, evidence-backed verdict, and governance trigger.
why_now: v0.2.1 schema/verifier hardening just completed, so this is the right point to check coherence before adding v0.3 pilot scenarios.
